parts:
Rho is constant over time, and the same for all replicates.

Finn

On 31 Aug 2022, at 23:17, JJ Hubbard <jordanj...@gmail.com> wrote:

﻿The INLA AR(1) doc gives:

x1 ∼ N (0,(τ (1 − ρ 2 ))−1 ) 
xi = ρ xi−1 + i ; i ∼ N (0, τ −1 ) i = 2, . . . , n

as the math for an AR model. Is there a single distribution for rho learned for all subjects in a replicate model? Or Does each subject get their own rho distribution that will be learned?

Also, is rho constant between time indices for an AR(1), or is there a unique distribution for rho between t=1 and t=2, and between t=3 and t=4?

Thank you very much
